00069 #define UnaryOpUGenProcessBlock(shouldDelete_, blockID_, channel_, OPFUNCTION_INTERNAL)           \
00070   int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();                 \
00071   float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();                  \
00072   float* inputSamples = inputs[Operand].processBlock(shouldDelete_, blockID_, channel_);         \
00073                                 \
00074    while(numSamplesToProcess--)                      \
00075    {                             \
00076     *outputSamples++ = OPFUNCTION_INTERNAL(*inputSamples++);              \
00077    }                             \
00078 
00079 #define UnaryOpUGenProcessBlock_K(shouldDelete_, blockID_, channel_, OPFUNCTION_INTERNAL)          \
00080   const int krBlockSize = UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();                \
00081   unsigned int blockPosition = blockID % krBlockSize;                  \
00082   int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();                 \
00083   float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();                  \
00084   float* inputSamples = inputs[Operand].processBlock(shouldDelete_, blockID_, channel_);         \
00085                                 \
00086   int numKrSamples = blockPosition % krBlockSize;                   \
00087                                 \
00088    while(numSamplesToProcess > 0) {                     \
00089     float nextValue = value;                      \
00090     if(numKrSamples == 0) nextValue = OPFUNCTION_INTERNAL(*inputSamples);           \
00091                                 \
00092     numKrSamples = krBlockSize - numKrSamples;                  \
00093                                 \
00094     blockPosition  += numKrSamples;                   \
00095     inputSamples  += numKrSamples;                   \
00096                                 \
00097     if(nextValue == value) {                      \
00098      while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples) {                \
00099       *outputSamples++ = nextValue;                   \
00100       --numSamplesToProcess;                     \
00101       --numKrSamples;                       \
00102      }                           \
00103     } else {                          \
00104      float valueSlope = (nextValue - value) / (float)UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();       \
00105      while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples) {                \
00106       *outputSamples++ = value;                    \
00107       value += valueSlope;                     \
00108       --numSamplesToProcess;                     \
00109       --numKrSamples;                       \
00110      }                           \
00111      value = nextValue;                       \
00112     }                            \
00113    }                             \

00233   {                              \
00234    if(internal == 0) return UGenArray();                    \
00235                                 \
00236    UGenArray newArray(internal->size());                    \
00237                                 \
00238    for(int i = 0; i < internal->size(); i++)                   \
00239    {                             \
00240     newArray.internal->getArray()[i] = internal->getArray()[i].OPFUNCTION();          \

00242                                 \
00243    return newArray;                         \

00246   Buffer Buffer::OPFUNCTION() const throw()                    \
00247   {                              \
00248    Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(size_, numChannels_, false));               \
00249                                 \
00250    for(int channelIndex = 0; channelIndex < numChannels_; channelIndex++)            \
00251    {                             \
00252     int numSamples = size_;                       \
00253     float* inputSamples = channels[channelIndex]->data;                \
00254     float* outputSamples = newBuffer.channels[channelIndex]->data;             \
00255                                 \
00256     while(--numSamples >= 0) {                      \
00257      *outputSamples++ = ugen::OPFUNCTION_INTERNAL(*inputSamples++);            \
00258     }                            \
00259    }                             \
00260                                 \
00261    return newBuffer;                         \
00262   }                              \
